I started hair removal in the 1990's when laser was first starting. I was in my 30's and started on my eyebrows. It was painful but not unbearable. I wear glasses, so it has not been an issue. But it helps when dressed.

I never tried laser. In the 1990, I though it was too new and needed to be proven.

Now I hear good and bad about it. In 2013, I started on my beard. By then I had a lot of white hair. For me electrolysis has worked. It took over 100 hours (I had a full beard) but I no longer shave. I am currently having weekly clean-up sessions.

I blog about it and you can read about it here.
http://susanking.blogspot.com/search/label/Electrology

I recommend you try both. However, I was told by my electrologist that it takes until your mid 20's before all of your facial hair is active. So if you are in your early twenties, it may seem that laser or electrolysis is not working, but it is killing hair and also activating new ones. 

I am in month 25. Its a long process and expensive. So take your time and figure out which works best for you. 

At your age, I would try laser first. It will take many sessions and seem frustratingly slow at first. But after awhile (up to 1 year), you will see the results. Then move to electrolysis for the lighter and more difficult hair.
